It operates locally without requiring API keys or cloud services, meaning there are no per-query costs. The project aims to provide a structured environment for humans and AI agents to work together effectively.

The project aims to offer a fast and efficient way to perform these calculations without requiring Python or specialized graphics hardware.

repos.name: wenyi

repos.name: personal-model

This model runs locally on your Mac and is designed to be private by default.

repos.name: wardrobe

repos.name: grok-build

repos.name: GNM

repos.name: comic-chat

Users communicate through cartoon avatars with messages displayed in speech bubbles.

repos.name: Codex-Dream-Skin

It enables users to change the background image and apply different visual themes without altering the official application files. The project provides scripts for both macOS and Windows to install and switch between these custom themes, aiming to create a more personalized coding environment.

repos.name: cuelume

repos.summary: Cuelume is a collection of fourteen carefully designed interaction sounds for the web. It provides clear feedback for buttons, links, and toggles without requiring developers to create their own sounds. These sounds are synthesized live using the Web Audio API and have no external dependencies.

repos.name: sakuramedia

It offers a centralized hub for discovering, subscribing to, and automatically downloading videos, with features like information translation and scene similarity search. The project is developed using Flutter, providing support across multiple platforms including desktop and mobile applications.

repos.name: Aether-GUI

repos.summary: This project provides a desktop application that makes it easy to use Aether, a tool for bypassing internet censorship. The application handles the complex setup and connection process automatically in the background.

repos.name: gemma-skills
repos.description: Skills for the Gemma and model/agent interactions
repos.summary: This project provides "skills" for interacting with Gemma, a type of AI model. One skill helps with building applications using Gemma or answering questions about Gemma models. Another skill allows users to train or adjust Gemma models on their own computers.

repos.name: scroll-world
repos.description: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world

As you scroll, a camera flies through different scenes without any cuts, creating a continuous journey. repos.name: skillhub

repos.name: vphone-aio

repos.name: JSTprove

repos.summary: JSTprove is a toolkit that creates verifiable proofs for artificial intelligence (AI) models. It takes an ONNX model and its inputs, then generates a proof that the AI model's calculations were performed correctly. This process involves preparing the model, creating a mathematical representation, and then using a proving system called Expander to generate and verify the proof.

repos.name: dsperse

It takes AI models in a format called ONNX and breaks them down into smaller pieces that can be used to create special mathematical proofs. DSperse then manages the process of compiling these pieces, running the AI model, generating proofs that the model ran correctly, and verifying those proofs.

repos.name: Aether
repos.summary: Aether is a program designed to help people access the internet on networks that block or restrict access. It finds ways to connect, creates a secure, hidden path for your internet traffic, and then makes a local proxy available for your applications to use. repos.name: pocketjs

This project enables the creation of UIs that can run on various hardware, including game consoles like the PSP and PS Vita, as well as in web browsers through WebAssembly.

repos.name: agent-chief

This system aims to reduce unnecessary interruptions by intelligently filtering and prioritizing incoming information.

repos.name: codex-auth-helper

repos.name: Pekingman

This system is useful for virtual NPCs, digital humans, and simulation games.

repos.name: go-ddd

It provides pre-built components and patterns to help developers separate business logic from infrastructure concerns, manage data changes reliably, and handle requests safely. The template includes features like Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) for separating read and write operations, and idempotency keys to ensure requests are processed only once.

repos.name: LiveAgent

repos.name: firstmate

It can download videos in different formats, convert them, and handle video information. The tool also supports downloading audio, playlists, and subtitles, and allows you to choose specific video quality and download locations.

repos.name: llm-space

repos.summary: HiDream-O1-Image is a model that creates images from text descriptions, edits existing images, and personalizes subjects based on provided examples. It can generate images at a high resolution of up to 2,048 × 2,048 pixels. The project also includes a reasoning agent that helps refine prompts before image generation.

repos.name: OpenSuperWhisper
repos.description: macOS dictation app
repos.summary: OpenSuperWhisper is a macOS application that records and transcribes audio in real-time. It uses transcription engines called Whisper and Parakeet, and allows users to download models directly within the app. The application supports various input methods like keyboard shortcuts and mouse buttons, and can transcribe audio files by dragging and dropping them.

repos.name: OfficeCLI
repos.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite  purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.
repos.summary: OfficeCLI is a free, open-source tool designed for AI agents to interact with Microsoft Office files. It allows AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint documents without needing to install Microsoft Office. The project includes a built-in rendering engine that allows AI agents to "see" documents by converting them to HTML or PNG.

repos.name: Minari
repos.description: A standard format for offline reinforcement learning datasets, with popular reference datasets and related utilities
repos.summary: Minari is a Python library that provides a standard format for datasets used in offline reinforcement learning, which is a type of machine learning where an agent learns from pre-collected data. It offers popular reference datasets and tools to help researchers work with this data. The library allows users to list, download, and read these datasets, as well as create their own.

repos.name: chinese-poetry-api
repos.description: 📜 诗泉：高性能中国古诗词 API 服务
repos.summary: This project provides a high-performance API service for Chinese classical poetry. It offers access to a large collection of poems, including Tang poems, Song lyrics, and Yuan songs, and supports searching by title, content, or author. The service can provide results in both simplified and traditional Chinese and offers both REST and GraphQL interfaces.

repos.name: kairos
repos.description: Official code for world model Kairos
repos.summary: Kairos is a world model designed for unified understanding, generation, and action prediction. It learns from various data sources, including general videos, human behavior, and real-robot interactions, to build persistent representations of the world. Kairos jointly predicts future visual states and executable robot actions, enabling long-horizon reasoning and generation for embodied artificial intelligence.

repos.name: lazycodex
repos.description: The one and only agent harness for complex codebases. Project memory, planning, execution, and verified completion inside Codex.
repos.summary: LazyCodex is an agent harness designed for complex codebases. It provides project memory, planning, execution, and verified completion capabilities within Codex. This project packages the OmO agent harness for Codex, offering features like disciplined agents, parallel execution, and multi-model routing.

repos.name: make-interfaces-feel-better
repos.description: Skill that makes your interfaces feel better.
repos.summary: This project is a skill designed to improve the user experience of interfaces by focusing on small details. It helps with aspects like animations, text appearance, how elements react when hovered over, and the use of shadows. After it runs, it provides a summary of changes and can answer follow-up questions.

repos.name: loupe
repos.description: A privacy-focused iOS app that raises awareness about what native apps can see
repos.summary: Loupe is an app for iPhones and iPads that shows you what information native apps can access on your device. It displays raw values from public iOS APIs, which are the same ones any app can use, to help you understand how your device might be recognized. The app categorizes this information into what's visible without permission, what requires your explicit consent, and more advanced methods apps can use.

repos.name: pi-computer-use
repos.description: Let Pi control your apps on MacOS & Windows
repos.summary: This project allows AI agents to control applications on macOS and Windows computers. It enables agents to see what is on an app's screen, understand its elements, and perform actions like clicking, typing, and scrolling. This is helpful when an AI needs to interact with a regular desktop application rather than using specialized programming interfaces.

repos.name: ponytail
repos.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
repos.summary: This project, called Ponytail, aims to make AI agents write code more efficiently by emulating a "lazy senior developer" who prioritizes simplicity. It encourages writing only necessary code, resulting in less code, lower costs, and faster execution, while maintaining safety. Ponytail works by guiding the AI through a series of checks before writing code, such as determining if the code is needed at all or if existing solutions can be reused.

repos.name: CPA-Manager-Plus
repos.description: Self-hosted AI gateway monitoring — track requests, cost, failures, quota, and account health for CPA / CLIProxyAPI and OpenAI-compatible gateways.
repos.summary: CPA Manager Plus is a self-hosted tool that monitors AI gateways. It tracks requests, costs, failures, and account health for systems like CPA and OpenAI-compatible gateways. This allows users to manage providers, credentials, and configurations while keeping a history of requests and cost analysis locally.

repos.name: ossie
repos.description: Apache Ossie, industry wide specification effort to standardize how we exchange semantic metadata across analytics, AI and BI platforms, providing a vendor neutral, single source of truth for semantic data
repos.summary: Apache Ossie is an effort to create a standard way to share information about data, called semantic metadata, across different analytics, AI, and business intelligence tools. It provides a single, consistent definition for data that can be understood by any tool, preventing confusion and ensuring that data meanings remain the same no matter where they are used. This helps avoid problems like the same key performance indicator being defined differently in various systems.

repos.name: autoremesher
repos.description: Automatic quad remeshing tool
repos.summary: AutoRemesher is a tool that automatically converts complex 3D shapes, called high-polygon meshes, into simpler shapes made of four-sided polygons, known as quad-based topology. This process is called quad remeshing. It helps create cleaner digital models.

repos.name: codex-app-mirror
repos.description: 原样镜像官方 Codex 桌面应用:每 15 分钟探测、SHA256 可校验、国内直连下载、 Mac 可增量更新 | Verbatim, verifiable mirror of the official Codex desktop app — probed every 15 min, with a Sparkle delta-update feed.
repos.summary: This project mirrors the official Codex desktop application's installer files. It checks for updates every 15 minutes and provides verifiable downloads for both Windows and macOS. For macOS users, it also offers a way to get incremental updates, meaning only the changes between versions are downloaded.

repos.name: awesome-osint-arsenal
repos.description: 🔍 Curated OSINT & recon toolkit for Kali Linux — 100+ tools, one-command installer, covering SOCMINT, GEOINT, network recon, dark web, forensics & more.
repos.summary: This project is a curated collection of tools for Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT) and security reconnaissance, designed for Kali Linux. It offers over 751 tools across 50 categories, including SOCMINT (Social Media Intelligence), GEOINT (Geospatial Intelligence), network reconnaissance, dark web exploration, and digital forensics. The project provides a one-command installer for easy setup and allows users to pick specific tool categories if needed.

repos.name: nihaisha-nishi-tcm
repos.description: 倪海厦中医课程资料的 Agent Skill：支持课程检索、方证穴位辨析、学习笔记整理与板书截图证据索引。 |  An Agent Skill for Ni Haisha TCM course study, formula-pattern lookup, acupoint reference, and screenshot evidence indexing.
repos.summary: This project organizes Ni Haisha's Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) course materials into a searchable system. It allows users to find information about specific symptoms, herbal formulas, acupuncture points, and course modules. The system also supports searching for learning notes and indexing screenshot evidence from the course.

repos.name: gaokaomath
repos.description: 历年高考数学真题，1952-2026
repos.summary: This project collects past Gaokao (national college entrance examination) mathematics exam papers. It aims to provide a historical archive of these exams from 1952 to 2026. The project details the evolution of the Gaokao mathematics exams, including reforms and changes in curriculum standards.

repos.name: mesh-llm
repos.description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.
repos.summary: Mesh LLM is a project that pools computing resources, like GPUs and memory, from multiple machines to power artificial intelligence models, specifically large language models (LLMs). It makes these pooled resources available through an API that is compatible with OpenAI's, allowing users to run agents and chat applications. The system can distribute models across different machines, even splitting large models into stages to run on multiple boxes if needed.

repos.name: corsair
repos.description: Your Agent's Integration Layer
repos.summary: Corsair is a system that acts as a secure bridge between an agent, which is a type of software that can perform tasks, and other applications. It allows agents to connect to and use various applications without directly handling sensitive login information. Corsair also provides controls to manage what actions the agent can perform and requires approval for certain operations, like sending an email, to prevent unintended consequences.
